title: THC Simple User Guide
subtitle: A starter path from setup to cure.
intro: What stage you are in → what the plant needs → what to do → what to avoid → what comes next.
visualStatus: Final infographic images are not included in this source batch; the page intentionally publishes the approved scripts without broken or placeholder art.

pages.title: Setup
pages.lead: Get ready before you start seeds.
pages.simpleRule: Set up first. Start seeds second.

pages.title: Seeds
pages.lead: A seed wakes up with moisture and warmth.
pages.avoid: Drowning it or checking too much.

pages.title: Seedling
pages.lead: A seedling is a baby plant.
pages.avoid: Too much water, food, or strong light.

pages.title: Veg
pages.lead: Veg is when the plant grows bigger.

sections.label: Do
sections.text: Water when the pot starts to dry.

pages.title: Flower
pages.lead: Flower is when buds begin to form.
pages.moveOn: Buds getting bigger and smell getting stronger.

pages.title: Harvest
pages.lead: Harvest means cutting the plant when buds are ready.
pages.avoid: Cutting early because you are excited.
pages.simpleRule: Harvest when the plant is ready.

pages.title: Dry
pages.lead: Drying slowly removes moisture after harvest.
pages.avoid: Heat, bright light, and direct fan blast.
pages.moveOn: Buds feel dry outside and small stems bend or snap.
pages.simpleRule: Fast drying can ruin good flower.

pages.title: Cure
pages.lead: Curing is the final step after drying.

sections.label: Do
sections.text: Open containers early if moisture builds up.

pages.title: Pests
pages.lead: Pests are problems that can damage plants.

sections.label: Beginner rules that matter most
items: Change one thing at a time
